targets.intent: Find the button that begins the insurance quote process
targets.expected_stable_signal: button with data-testid='start-quote-btn' and aria-label='Start your insurance quote'; Vue data-v-2b3c4d scope attr is volatile

targets.intent: Find the link that saves the current quote progress so you can continue later
targets.expected_stable_signal: anchor with href='/quote/save' and aria-label='Save your quote progress and continue later'

targets.intent: Find the step indicator button for Step 1 in the quote wizard
targets.expected_stable_signal: element inside quote-wizard shadow root (level-1) with data-testid='step-1-indicator' and aria-label='Step 1: Personal Information'

targets.intent: Find the button inside the quote wizard that advances to Step 2
targets.expected_stable_signal: button inside quote-wizard shadow root (level-1) with data-testid='next-step-btn' and aria-label='Continue to step 2: Property Details'

targets.intent: Find the first name input field in Step 1 of the quote wizard
targets.expected_stable_signal: input inside form-section shadow root (level-2, step=1) with id='quote-first-name', name='first_name', and aria-label='First name'

targets.intent: Find the date of birth input in Step 1 of the quote wizard
targets.expected_stable_signal: input[type=date] inside form-section shadow root (level-2, step=1) with id='quote-dob' and aria-label='Your date of birth'

targets.intent: Find the dropdown for selecting the property type in Step 2 of the quote wizard
targets.expected_stable_signal: select inside form-section shadow root (level-2, step=2) with id='property-type', name='property_type', and aria-label='Property type'

targets.intent: Find the input where you enter the desired coverage amount in pounds
targets.expected_stable_signal: input inside form-section shadow root (level-2, step=3) with aria-label='Desired coverage amount in GBP'

targets.intent: Find the progress bar element that indicates how far through the quote wizard you are
targets.expected_stable_signal: NONE — div inside quote-wizard shadow root (level-1) with class progress-fill and role=progressbar only; no stable id, no aria-label text, no data-testid; failure classification: observation_lacked_stable_signal

targets.intent: Find the submit button in Step 3 that requests the final insurance quote
targets.expected_stable_signal: button inside form-section shadow root (level-2, step=3) with data-testid='submit-quote-btn' and aria-label='Submit your quote request'
